text:
Ana: FYI I reproduced the hang: safetensors file with index_offset set to 0 (artifact pipeline bug) causes loader to wait for sidecar index forever. Proposal: gate on header.index_offset > 0 and index_checksum valid, else immediate fallback.

Hector: That mirrors what we discussed last month. Two new asks: 1) make fallback visible in runtime traces so we can correlate customer reports; 2) provide an opt-in strict mode for enterprise customers who want load to fail rather than silently fallback.

Lucy: Opt-in strict mode sounds reasonable: model metadata flag `strict_index_required=true` -> loader returns ERROR on missing/bad index. Default remains to fallback.

Ben: For traces/metrics: add safetensors.index_check{status=missing|bad|ok} and safetensors.fallback{artifact_hash}. Also increment artifact_fallback_counter hashed.

infra-bot: Noted. Will add metric names to metrics-lib and implement hashed tagging.

Ana: Edgecase: index present but offset points beyond file length (truncated upload). Treat as BAD_INDEX. Emit full header snapshot to debug logs but not to metrics to avoid PII/leak.

Hector: Also protect against DoS: if artifact triggers fallback repeatedly, bump its cost-profile so scheduler deprioritizes it. Add `artifact_cost_multiplier` metadata update on 3+ fallbacks.

Lucy: I'll add test harness for truncated files and strict mode. Ben can wire metrics.

Ben: I'll create dashboards: index_check rate, fallback rate, quarantine list.

Ana: Great. Plan: land loader guard + metrics this week, follow with strict-mode RFC for enterprise owners.

Hector: Thanks everyone.
